subject: english
stem: Which sentence uses the for a unique role in the local situation?
options: A principal of our school, but nobody knows which one, will speak.
The principal will speak at our school assembly.

optionRationales.reason: A principal of our school, but nobody knows which one, will speak.：描述與局部唯一角色矛盾。
Principal the will our speak.：語序錯誤。
An principal speaks.：發音與功能不合。
The principal will speak at our school assembly.：our school 的校長在此局部情境可辨認。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「以先前提及、情境唯一、後置限定或共同知識判斷聽者能否辨認名詞，據此使用 the。」可推出 The principal will speak at our school assembly.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 The principal will speak at our school assembly. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
